title: ClaudeTools configuration
description: Drives `ct render`. Every token below is substituted into templates/ as {{TOKEN}}. Tokens are grouped by namespace; `ct check` fails on any unrendered token, and on any schema token that no template uses (dead vocabulary).

PROJECT_NAME.description: Human-readable project name, e.g. 'Dynamic ORM Platform'.

PROJECT_DESCRIPTION.description: One-line description used in generated doc headers.

PROJECT_MAIN_BRANCH.description: Default integration branch. PRs target this unless a skill says otherwise.

PROJECT_ROOT_DOC.description: Path to the repo's root agent-instruction file.

tracker.description: Issue tracker adapter. Command tokens are shell command templates; ${ID} interpolates the issue id, ${BODY}/${LABEL}/${STATUS} their obvious arguments. A profile in templates/trackers/<kind>/ supplies defaults for every token here.

TRACKER_ISSUE_REF_FORMAT.description: How an issue is written inline, with ${ID}. GitHub '#${ID}'; JIRA '${ID}' (keys are already qualified, e.g. PROJ-123).

TRACKER_ISSUE_URL.description: Browser URL for an issue, with ${ID}.

TRACKER_LIST_ISSUES.description: Command listing open issues for triage.

TRACKER_COMMENT_ISSUE.description: Command posting a comment, with ${ID} and ${BODY}.

TRACKER_ADD_LABEL.description: Command adding a label/tag, with ${ID} and ${LABEL}.

TRACKER_SET_STATUS.description: Command moving the issue's workflow state, with ${ID} and ${STATUS}. Empty string if the tracker has no board.

TRACKER_LOCK_MECHANISM.description: One-sentence prose naming how the agent mutex is represented (GitHub: an agent:* label; JIRA: a field or assignee convention; none: a lockfile). Rendered into workflow prose so a reader is never told to use a mechanism the tracker lacks.

TRACKER_LOCK_ACQUIRE.description: Command acquiring the agent working lock.

TRACKER_LOCK_QUERY.description: Command printing an issue's current lock state, for stale-lock recovery.

TRACKER_CLOSE_KEYWORD.description: PR-body phrase that auto-closes on merge, with ${ID}. GitHub 'Closes #${ID}'; JIRA often a smart commit 'Closes ${ID}' or empty if unsupported.

TRACKER_REF_KEYWORD.description: PR-body phrase that links WITHOUT closing, for partial delivery. GitHub 'Refs #${ID}'.

TRACKER_BOARD_NAME.description: Display name of the board, for prose.

TRACKER_BOARD_URL.description: Board URL, for prose. Empty if none.

TRACKER_CREATE_ISSUE.description: Command creating a new issue, with ${TITLE} and ${BODY}.

vcs.description: Code-host adapter for pull/merge requests and review threads.

VCS_REPO_URL.description: Browser URL of the repo root.

VCS_CREATE_DRAFT_PR.description: Same, as a draft. Empty if the host has no draft concept.

VCS_PR_CHECKS.description: Command listing CI check status for a PR.

VCS_MARK_READY.description: Command flipping a draft to ready. Empty if unsupported.

VCS_LIST_REVIEW_THREADS.description: Command listing review threads with resolution state.

VCS_RESOLVE_THREAD.description: Command resolving one review thread, with ${THREAD}. Empty if unsupported — the resolve-review-feedback skill degrades to replying instead.

VCS_PR_URL_FORMAT.description: Browser URL for a PR, with ${PR}.

VCS_RERUN_FAILED_CHECKS.description: Command re-running only failed CI jobs. Empty if unsupported.

vocab.description: Nouns. Rendered into prose so a JIRA/GitLab shop never reads GitHub vocabulary.

VOCAB_REVIEWER.description: Name of the bot reviewer whose feedback the review-feedback skill processes, e.g. 'Copilot'.

pkg.description: Build/test commands. Every skill and agent that says 'run typecheck' renders the real command here.

PKG_MANAGER.description: npm | pnpm | yarn | bun | cargo | uv | make | ...

PKG_BUILD.description: Build. Empty string if the project has no build step — prose that mentions building is dropped at render.

PKG_SYNC_AGENTS.description: Regenerate derived agent-instruction files (the sync-agent-instructions script). Empty if the repo has no secondary agent consumers.

paths.description: Where things live in the consuming repo.

PATHS_SRC_GLOBS.description: Space-separated globs of first-party source, git-ls-files style. Used as the citation corpus by build-frozen-headings.sh — a heading cited in a source comment must be discoverable here.

packs.description: Opt-in stack packs installed alongside core. Each name must match a directory under templates/packs/.

ci.description: Which CI wiring to emit for the governance gates.

upstream.description: Only used by `ct extract` when refreshing templates from an upstream repo. Never read at render time.

path.description: Local filesystem path to the upstream checkout. Read-only — extract never writes there.

lastSha.description: Upstream commit the templates were last extracted from.
